prompts.male_upper:
Use case: stylized-concept. TILMO male hero RUN animation sprite sheet, preserve character identity from attached reference, silver spiky hair, blue goggles, red scarf, navy/white/gold costume. BOTH HANDS EMPTY. Wide landscape sheet exactly 8 columns x 4 rows, 32 full-body sprites. Large 2048x1024 canvas ideal, equal square cells, one sprite per cell with clear padding and consistent anatomy/scale. Row directions TOP TO BOTTOM: 1 NORTH back; 2 NORTHEAST back-right; 3 EAST right profile; 4 SOUTHEAST front-right. Fixed overhead three-quarter orthographic camera, matching high-quality anime cartoon game sprites.
CRITICAL: Each row must show a COMPLETE TWO-STEP RUN CYCLE with visibly DIFFERENT alternating legs, NOT the same leg cycling twice. Sequential columns 1 to 8: (1) LEFT foot reaches forward to contact, RIGHT leg extended behind; (2) weight compresses over LEFT foot, right heel lifts; (3) RIGHT knee drives forward past left, left foot pushes off behind; (4) BOTH feet off ground, RIGHT thigh forward, LEFT knee trailing; (5) RIGHT foot reaches forward to contact, LEFT leg extended behind; (6) weight compresses over RIGHT foot, left heel lifts; (7) LEFT knee drives forward past right, right foot pushes off; (8) BOTH feet off ground, LEFT thigh forward, RIGHT knee trailing, loops naturally to frame 1. Opposite arm swings to each forward leg. Full visible stride, strong knee flexion, shoulders and hips rotate subtly. Frame 1 and frame 5 must have opposite legs forward. Flight frames 4 and 8 have entire body 5 percent higher, do NOT put their boots on ground baseline. Head size stays constant, scarf follows through. Character centered around same torso x-position in every cell. Maintain transparent breathing room around all figures; all hair/boots/scarf inside own cell. Genuine transparent background. NO weapon, shadow, effects, labels, numbers, grid lines, scenery, extra figures, duplicate poses, missing cells. Crisp clear edges, no motion blur.
